t^2-20t-20c=0 .
\]

Thus \(t\) satisfies a quadratic with sum of roots \(t_1+t_2=20\).  
The corresponding \(x\)-values are \(x_i=2026^{\,t_i}\), so

\[
x_1x_2=2026^{\,t_1+t_2}=2026^{20}.
\]

Factor \(2026\):

\[
2026=2\cdot1013,\qquad 1013\text{ is prime}.
\]

Hence

\[
2026^{20}=2^{20}\cdot1013^{20}.
\]

The number of positive divisors of a number \(p_1^{e_1}p_2^{e_2}\) is \((e_1+1)(e_2+1)\).  
Here \(e_1=e_2=20\), so

\[
d(2026^{20})=(20+1)(20+1)=21\cdot21=441.
\]

\[
\boxed{441}
\]
